headline: Finance and Facilities Committee to discuss budget timeline, board budget guidance, facilities master plan, and commissioner stipend.
summary: The committee will discuss the budget timeline and board budget guidance, review updates to the facilities master plan and facilities use procedure, and discuss the commissioner stipend.
location: Hunt Middle School - Library, 1364 North Avenue
